blocks.tamil_translation: said, "All of you, go to that river and jump into it!" There I saw a wide river flowing; its water was white like milk. Those people jumped into that river. Then, when they came back to us, their ugliness had gone and they had become completely beautiful. The two angels said to me, This is the Jannah called "Adn". This is your house. There I saw a palace like a white cloud. "This is your house," they said. I said to them, May Allah grant barakah to both of you! Let me go! I will go inside. They said, "Not now; you will go later!" I asked them, "What were the astonishing scenes I saw tonight?' They said, "We shall explain them. The first man you saw, whose head was being crushed, is the one who learned the Qur'an and then abandoned it (he neither recited it nor acted upon it) and who slept without praying the Fard Salah. The (second) man whose face was being torn and ripped apart is the one who leaves his house in the morning and tells a lie, and that lie spreads throughout the world. (Third,) the naked men and women burning in the fire pit are those who engaged in adultery. (Fourth,) the one swimming in the river and having stones thrown into his mouth is the one who takes interest. (Fifth,) the man who was kindling the fire and running around it is Malik, the keeper of Jahannam. (Sixth,) the man in the garden is Hazrat Ibrahim (AS), and the children all around him are those who died in childhood upon the natural religion, Islam." At that point one of the Sahabah asked, "O Rasulullah! What will be the state of the children of those who associate partners with Allah?'
